text: On the authority of Abu Saeed Al-Khudri - may God be pleased with him - he said: Whenever the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was looking for a garment, he would give it its name: either a shirt or a turban, and then he would say: O God, praise be to You, You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness of what was made for it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what was made for it.
